title: Harmonic batcher: passive probing, workload fingerprints, and safe continuous policy apply
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a recommendation engine (codename: Harmonic) that passively profiles production inference traffic, derives workload fingerprints, synthesizes batching + caching parameter proposals, and applies them with a guarded continuous rollout and rollback path. Focus on low-risk first-pass rules, telemetry for regressions, and a human-in-the-loop approval flow for P0 customers.
background: Current autotune work is effective for synthetic profiles but we still see customer regressions when live traffic has microburst patterns or heavy KV cache reuse not captured by offline probes. Harmonic will combine passive sampling, lightweight sketching of sequence-length and KV-reuse patterns, and a conservative policy synthesizer to recommend batching.window_size, max_batch, queue_timeout_ms, and prefix_cache_ttl configs. It should integrate with Console rollout controls and runtime shadow-apply hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Passive profiler runs on dedicated sampling nodes with <1% p99 latency overhead for production requests
Fingerprint schema defined (sequence_length_distribution, kv_reuse_ratio, request_interarrival_quantiles, model_variant) and validation test included
Synthesizer outputs a ranked list of up to 3 safe parameter proposals per model+pool with expected cost delta and rollback signal thresholds
Safe-apply pipeline implemented: dry-run -> shadow-apply (traffic mirrored) -> canary (1% traffic) -> ramp with automated rollback triggers
Console shows proposal diff, cost estimate, safety score, and audit log entries for all actions
E2E tests for rollback triggers (latency increase, output-regression signal) and telemetry alerts in place
deliverables: passive profiler binary and lightweight sketching library
fingerprint+heuristics spec doc (Confluence link in links)
synthesizer service + scoring model for safety/cost tradeoffs
safe-apply operator integrated with rollout service and Console UI
integration tests and runbook for rollback and incident postmortem
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: passive sampling could miss rare microburst modes -> Mitigation: combine passive with short active probers on a subset of traffic
Risk: automated apply introduces regressions for edge tenants -> Mitigation: default to manual approval for customers with high SLAs, and require canary shadow period
Risk: cost model inaccuracy -> Mitigation: surface uncertainty bands and conservative savings estimates, require opt-in for aggressive saves
implementation_notes: Fingerprint format: JSON lines with base64-encoded compact sketches; keep schema versioned
Use existing KV telemetry: extend tracer to emit reuse counts per request; calculate rolling kv_reuse_ratio per 1m window
Synthesizer will start as rule-based with thresholds derived from historical sims; later replaceable by a lightweight ranking ML model
Safe-apply will reuse rollout service feature flags and add rollout-phase hooks to the runtime that accept rollback predicates
Telemetry: emit proposal_id, applied_phase, phase_metrics (latency_p50/p95/p99, token_cost_per_k, error_rate), and safety_score
